groups.sentence: Universities provide students and advisors with contact information, resource lists and a designated referral point for human assistance.
Instructors connect students to library, writing, tutoring and other academic support resources and remind them of these resources.
Students reach out to instructors, librarians, writing centers or academic support services for help with their work, including before turning to AI.
Academic integrity questions and suspected AI misuse go to conduct, honor code or student rights offices.
Students can get help from writing centers, tutoring, librarians, advisors and instructors, which are available resources.
Everyone directs questions about AI security, privacy, compliance, tools or data to IT, information security or the CISO.
Questions about AI policy are directed to designated university officials, offices or committees.
Everyone contacts a librarian to confirm citations, licensed content, copyright or whether a resource may be uploaded to AI.
Students check with instructors or advisors about course policies and their use of AI.
